19.issue_summary: User-Initiated Collection: Disclosure exempt, but must be declared in Play Store form.
19.evidence: In billing.ts, lib/billing.js, and kitesurfPaymentAgent.ts, transaction records and invoice receipts are saved to Firestore under users/{uid}/payments during user-initiated subscription and billing flows.
19.recommendation: Declare PURCHASE_HISTORY collection under the Financial Info / Purchase History category in the Play Store Data Safety form.

21.evidence: In LocationManager.kt (line 19) and MainViewModel+Concerts.kt (lines 31-41), fine location (latitude/longitude) is retrieved via FusedLocationProviderClient and automatically sent off-device to the 'searchConcerts' Firebase Cloud Function on screen load without prior prominent disclosure or user consent.
21.recommendation: Add an in-app prominent disclosure dialog explaining precise location data collection and obtain explicit user consent prior to fetching location and transmitting it off-device.

22.evidence: In LocationManager.kt (lines 12-26) and MainViewModel+Concerts.kt (lines 30-41), approximate location coordinates are retrieved and automatically transmitted off-device to the 'searchConcerts' Firebase Cloud Function when loading concert data without prior prominent disclosure.
22.recommendation: Implement a prominent disclosure and obtain explicit user consent before accessing and transmitting location data off-device.
